post.caption: De Beers launched the right-hand ring. For decades, De Beers sold diamonds as romance. In 2003, its marketing arm set out to sell a right-hand ring. J. Walter Thompson wrote the ads for glossy magazines. The slogan was, Women of the world, raise your right hand. Your left hand says we, and your right hand says me. The left hand keeps the engagement ring. The right-hand ring is one a woman buys herself. It needed a diamond of at least a fifth of a carat. It could hold any number of stones except three. Three stones would look like an anniversary ring.
